standard_prerequisites.name: The residual space is a monomorphism
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: definition of the residual space Z_x -> X used at proof line 3316 (Z_x -> X is a monomorphism by construction)
standard_prerequisites.use: The forward direction is immediate: if Z_x = Spec(k) the structural morphism represents x by a monomorphism.

standard_prerequisites.name: Fibres of monomorphisms towards a field
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms of Spaces, Lemma spaces-morphisms-lemma-monomorphism-toward-field, cited at proof lines 3322-3324
standard_prerequisites.use: A monomorphism of algebraic spaces towards Spec(k) whose source is nonempty is an isomorphism -- used twice in the converse.

standard_prerequisites.name: Nonemptiness of the fibred product
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Properties of Spaces, Lemma spaces-properties-lemma-points-cartesian, cited at proof lines 3320-3321
standard_prerequisites.use: Z_x x_X Spec(k) is nonempty, so the monomorphism towards Spec(k) is an isomorphism.

standard_prerequisites.name: Decent points are represented by monomorphisms
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Lemma lemma-decent-points-monomorphism of this chapter, cited at proof line 3327
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the final statement: decency of X gives the representing monomorphism for every point.

core_obligations: 主义务是等价的两向：正向（Z_x = Spec(k) ⇒ x 由单态射表示）是定义性的一步（Z_x -> X 本身是单态射）；反向（单态射表示 ⇒ Z_x = Spec(k)）要经基变换 Z_x x_X Spec(k) -> Spec(k)----它是单态射、源非空，故为同构，从而得到 Spec(k) -> Z_x 的单态射，再用 lemma-monomorphism-into-point 得同构。
收尾义务：'X decent 时对一切 x 成立' 交回本章 lemma-decent-points-monomorphism，本 span 不重复其论证。
反向段的嵌套单态射结构容易错位：先证 Z_x x_X Spec(k) = Spec(k)（第一个同构），读出 Spec(k) -> Z_x 是单态射（第二个单态射），再对它用 lemma-monomorphism-into-point（第三个同构）；三步的对象与方向必须逐一指认。
proof_roadmap: 正向（3316-3318）：Z_x -> X 是单态射；若 Z_x = Spec(k)，则 x 由 Spec(k) = Z_x -> X 表示。

反向第一步（3319-3324）：设 Spec(k) -> X 是表示 x 的单态射；则 Z_x x_X Spec(k) -> Spec(k) 是单态射且源非空（spaces-properties-lemma-points-cartesian），由 spaces-morphisms-lemma-monomorphism-toward-field 得 Z_x x_X Spec(k) = Spec(k)。
反向第二步（3324-3326）：由上得单态射 Spec(k) -> Z_x；它由 lemma-monomorphism-into-point（本卡另一条候选，此处为同章桩）是同构，故 Z_x = Spec(k)。
收尾（3327-3328）：X decent 时每点都被单态射表示（lemma-decent-points-monomorphism），最终陈述成立。
difficulty_reason: 等价两向都不长但对象嵌套三层（Z_x、基变换、再回来的单态射），每一步'谁是单态射、对谁用引理'容易错位；反向最后一步依赖的同章引理 lemma-monomorphism-into-point 本身也在这批卡里----两卡互引的关系要在 dedup 里写明以免复核误判循环。
